items.name: hud-layout
items.title: HUD Layout
items.description: Overlay HUD with four corner regions for status, meters and messages. The overlay ignores pointer events except on interactive children; each region is a labelled landmark; the whole HUD can be hidden.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Put interactive controls inside regions; they receive pointer events, everything else passes through. Provide your own control to toggle the hidden prop.
